description: Compiler scaffold + inputs + full front-end (parse/validate stages). Sets up the TypeScript/Node ESM package in compiler/, the design-token source of truth at the worktree root, the UserCard fixture, and every analysis stage that turns .adx inputs into validated data structures: shared error/source utilities, the structure tokenizer+parser (per docs/adx-grammar.md), the manifest loader+validator, the token loader, the behavior export scanner, and the build-time expression evaluator. Codegen is FEAT-002. This feature leaves the compiler building, tested, and lint-clean with all front-end stages covered by unit tests. Corresponds to plan.md items 1-9. Independent of FEAT-002/003 only in that it comes first; later features depend on it.
steps: Scaffold compiler/: package.json ("type":"module", name adx-compiler, bin adx -> dist/cli.js, scripts build=`tsc -p tsconfig.json`, test=`vitest run`, lint=`eslint .`), tsconfig.json (target ES2020, module NodeNext, rootDir src, outDir dist, strict), vitest.config.ts, eslint.config.js (flat config + @typescript-eslint), .gitignore (dist/, node_modules/), and src/index.ts placeholder. Run `npm install` adding devDeps typescript, vitest, eslint, @typescript-eslint/*. (plan item 1)

Create tokens/design-tokens.json at the WORKTREE ROOT (not under compiler/) encoding every token from docs/agent-reference.md: spacing space-0,1,2,3,4,6,8,12,16 (px, 4px scale); colors surface-0..3, text-1..3, primary, secondary, success, warning, error, info, border; radius sm/md/lg/full (4/8/12/9999); shadow sm/md/lg; typography text-xs..3xl (12..30px), weight normal/medium/bold (400/500/700), font sans/serif/mono; breakpoints sm/md/lg/xl (640/768/1024/1280). Pick accessible light-theme hex for colors meeting the UX/UI contrast baseline. Structure it so a loader maps tokens.<name> -> value and can list spacing indices. (plan item 2)

Create compiler/fixtures/user-card/ with all four files from the human-guide UserCard: manifest.json (name/version/props name,avatar,bio,role/emits click,follow/slots actions), structure.adx (article.card @click, img, content div, h2.name, p.role, p :if="bio", <slot actions />), behavior.adx.js (setup + onClick), style.adx.css (@use tokens; token-based styles). This is the golden compile input. (plan item 3)

Implement src/errors.ts (AdxError + formatError producing exactly `[ADX] <file>:<line> - <message>`, plus a line-less variant for manifest.json) and src/source.ts (offset -> 1-based line). (plan item 4)

Implement the structure tokenizer+parser per docs/adx-grammar.md: src/structure/tokenizer.ts, src/structure/parser.ts (parseStructure(src,file): Node[]), src/structure/ast.ts (types from grammar section 8), src/expr/parse-expr.ts (restricted ident/member expression sub-parser). Cover .class shorthand + class-merge precedence (grammar 2.5), :prop bindings, @event, plain attrs, {{interp}} in text and attribute values, :if/:else/:for/:key with fixed for>if>bindings order, <slot name />, void/self-closing elements, and the EXACT error messages (unterminated interp, :else without :if, duplicate slot, mismatched close tag, invalid :for, unsupported expression). (plan item 5)

Implement src/manifest/load.ts (loadManifest(dir): Manifest) + src/manifest/types.ts: validate required name/version and props/emits/slots/deps shapes; optional SEO metadata (title/description/schema) passes through; errors use line-less format e.g. `[ADX] manifest.json - Missing required field "name"`. (plan item 6)

Implement src/tokens/load.ts (loadTokens(path): TokenTable with resolve(ref), has(ref), availableSpacing() -> "0,1,2,3,4,6,8,12,16") + src/tokens/types.ts, reading tokens/design-tokens.json. (plan item 7)

Implement src/behavior/scan.ts (scanBehavior(src,file): BehaviorApi) + src/behavior/types.ts: find exports BY NAME (export function / export const), classify into setup, events on<Event>, computed get<Name>, lifecycle onMounted/onUnmounted/onUpdated. No deep JS parse. (plan item 8)

Implement src/expr/evaluate.ts: evaluate(expr, scope) safe walker over ident/member resolving loop scope -> setup state -> props -> getXxx computed results, undefined for unknowns; truthy()/toText() helpers (empty string falsy; null/undefined -> ""). (plan item 9)

Add Vitest tests for each stage under compiler/test/: errors.test.ts, structure-parser.test.ts (UserCard AST, :for index+key, :if/:else pairing, attribute interpolation, class merge, each error case with exact [ADX] message), manifest.test.ts, tokens.test.ts, behavior-scan.test.ts, evaluate.test.ts.
acceptance_criteria: From compiler/: `npm install` succeeds, `npm run build` produces dist/ via tsc with no errors, `npm run lint` passes.
`cd compiler && npm test` runs and all front-end unit tests pass (errors, structure parser, manifest, tokens, behavior scan, evaluate).
tokens/design-tokens.json exists at the worktree root, parses as JSON, and contains every documented token name.
compiler/fixtures/user-card/ contains the four files and the structure parser produces the AST shape from grammar section 8 for it.
Every error path emits the exact `[ADX] <file>:<line> - <message>` string (manifest errors omit the line), asserted by tests.
verification: cd compiler && npm install && npm run build && npm test && npm run lint
cd compiler && npx vitest run test/structure-parser.test.ts test/manifest.test.ts test/tokens.test.ts test/behavior-scan.test.ts test/evaluate.test.ts test/errors.test.ts
findings: FEAT-001 complete. All verification green: npm install/build(tsc)/test(52 passing)/lint all pass; tokens JSON parse ok; per-stage vitest ok. SCAFFOLD - compiler/ is an ESM package (name adx-compiler, "type":"module"). Scripts: build=`tsc -p tsconfig.json`, test=`vitest run`, lint=`eslint .`. bin adx -> dist/cli.js (cli.js is FEAT-002). - devDeps pinned: typescript 5.7.2, vitest 2.1.8, eslint 9.17.0, typescript-eslint 8.18.2 (+ @typescript-eslint/parser & eslint-plugin 8.18.2), @types/node 20.17.10 (REQUIRED for node:fs / node:path imports used by loaders). - tsconfig: target ES2020, module/moduleResolution NodeNext, rootDir src, outDir dist, strict + noUnusedLocals/Parameters/noImplicitReturns + verbatimModuleSyntax. IMPORTANT: with NodeNext + verbatimModuleSyntax, all intra-src relative imports MUST use the .js extension (e.g. `import { x } from "./errors.js"`) and type-only imports MUST use `import type`. tsconfig excludes test/ from the build (vitest compiles tests itself). - eslint.config.js is flat config via typescript-eslint; ignores dist/, node_modules/, fixtures/. - dist/ and node_modules/ gitignored (compiler/.gitignore). PUBLIC API (all re-exported from compiler/src/index.ts; import paths below are the source modules): - errors (src/errors.ts): class AdxError{file,adxLine?,message}; formatError(init:{file,message,line?}):string; adxError(file,line,message):AdxError; adxFileError(file,message):AdxError. Message format EXACTLY `[ADX] : - ` or line-less `[ADX] - `. - source (src/source.ts): class SourceText(text,file){ file; text; lineAt(offset):number /*1-based, binary search*/ }. - structure AST (src/structure/ast.ts): matches grammar section 8. Node = ElementNode|SlotNode|TextNode discriminated by `kind`. ElementNode{kind:'element',tag,line,classes:string[],bindings:Binding[],attrs:Attr[],events:EventBinding[],directives:Directives,children:Node[],selfClosing:boolean}. SlotNode{kind:'slot',name,classes:string[],line}. TextNode{kind:'text',line,parts:TextPart[]}. Binding{name, expr?:Expr, template?:TextPart[]} (expr for a bare/single-hole value, template for mixed literal+{{}} value). Attr{name,value:string|null}. EventBinding{name,handler}. Directives{if?:Expr, else?:true, for?:{item:string,index?:string,iterable:Expr}, key?:Expr}. TextPart = {lit:string}|{expr:Expr}. Expr = {kind:'ident',name}|{kind:'member',object:Expr,property:string}. - structure parser (src/structure/parser.ts): parseStructure(input:string, file:string):Node[]. Handles class-merge (literal class="" first then .shorthand, deduped), :prop(expr or template), @event, plain/boolean attrs, {{interp}} in text and attr values, :if/:else/:for/:key, , void+self-closing. Enforces exact error strings: 'Unterminated interpolation', '":else" without matching ":if"', 'Duplicate slot ""' (checked tree-wide after parse), 'Expected , found ', 'Invalid :for expression "" (expected "item in items")', 'Unsupported expression ""', 'Duplicate attribute ":src"', '":if" and ":else" on the same element'. - tokenizer (src/structure/tokenizer.ts): tokenize(src:SourceText):Token[]; Token = open|close|text; exports VOID_ELEMENTS:Set (img,input,br,hr,meta,link,... treated self-closing). - expr parser (src/expr/parse-expr.ts): parseExpr(raw,file,line):Expr. ONLY ident + dotted member; anything else throws Unsupported expression. - evaluate (src/expr/evaluate.ts): evaluate(expr:Expr, scope:EvalScope):unknown. EvalScope{locals?:Record[] /*innermost-first*/, state?, props?, computed?:Recordunknown)> /*keyed by BARE name e.g. displayName for getDisplayName; thunks are invoked*/}. Resolution order locals->state->props->computed; unknown->undefined. Helpers truthy(v) (JS falsy; '' is falsy) and toText(v) (null/undefined->''). - manifest (src/manifest/load.ts, types.ts): loadManifest(dir):Manifest reads /manifest.json; parseManifest(raw):Manifest for tests. Manifest{name,version,props:Record,emits:string[],slots:string[],deps:string[],seo?:SeoMeta}. PropDef{type:'string'|'number'|'boolean'|'array'|'object', required?,default?}. SeoMeta{title?,description?,schema?} (optional, passthrough). Errors line-less: `[ADX] manifest.json - Missing required field "name"` etc. - tokens (src/tokens/load.ts, types.ts): loadTokens(path):TokenTable from the JSON file; parseTokens(raw) for tests. TokenTable{resolve(ref):string, has(ref):boolean, availableSpacing():string /* '0,1,2,3,4,6,8,12,16' */, names():string[]}. ref accepts 'tokens.' or bare ''. resolve throws Error `Unknown token ""` on miss (NOT an AdxError yet — style stage in FEAT-002 should wrap into the `[ADX] style.adx.css: - Unknown token ...` format). - behavior (src/behavior/scan.ts, types.ts): scanBehavior(src, file?):BehaviorApi. By-NAME regex scan of top-level `export function|const|let|var `. BehaviorApi{hasSetup:boolean, events:string[] /*on excluding lifecycle*/, computed:string[] /*get*/, lifecycle:string[] /*onMounted/onUnmounted/onUpdated*/, other:string[], all:string[]} — all arrays sorted. TOKEN FILE SHAPE (tokens/design-tokens.json at WORKTREE ROOT, not under compiler/): top-level grouped maps `spacing|colors|radius|shadow|typography|breakpoints`, each `name->value` string. A scalar `$schema-note` key exists and the loader skips non-object groups. Light-theme accessible hex chosen. From compiler/, relative path to it is '../tokens/design-tokens.json'. FIXTURE (compiler/fixtures/user-card/): manifest.json (UserCard, props name/avatar/bio/role, emits click/follow, slots actions), structure.adx (article.card @click + img + content div + h2.name + p.role + p :if=bio + ), behavior.adx.js (setup/onClick/onFollowClick), style.adx.css (@use tokens). This is the golden compile input for FEAT-002 codegen/CLI + SEO HTML check. NOTES FOR FEAT-002: codegen/CLI not implemented. dist/cli.js is the declared bin target. The SEO contract (resolve {{}} at build time into static HTML, glue only hydrates) is unimplemented — use evaluate() + the AST to emit static HTML, and tokens.resolve() to emit CSS. The grammar's :else-pairs-by-sibling and for>if>bindings eval order are documented in docs/adx-grammar.md; the parser preserves source order and directive data for the emitter to apply.
